mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals labor market weakness that precedes corporate earnings deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1000) and consumer spending (RSAFS < 420000) indicate broad demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1000 and RSAFS < 420000, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 signals manufacturing contraction that precedes earnings declines, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days in supply-constrained regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer spending growth above 1.5% annually indicates robust household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS growth > 1.5%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
